verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a unified candidate record that holds resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history and consent status together. The closest items are adjacent: the applications and audit-event API endpoints, AI interview transcripts, and generic 'All-in-One' platform marketing. None of them describe a single candidate profile, and consent status is never mentioned.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record
